descriptionAr: Über uns Die Langlauf Security Automation GmbH mit Sitz in Lippstadt findet heraus, welche Open-Source- und Drittkomponenten in fertig kompilierter Software stecken. Wir brauchen dafür keinen Quellcode. Aus den Funden erzeugen wir eine Software-Stückliste (Software Bill of Materials, SBOM). Diese gleichen wir mit Schwachstellendatenbanken ab. Am Ende steht ein Bericht über die bekannten Schwachstellen der Softwar Aufgaben Deine Aufgaben Du startest mit zwei Projekten: 1. Komponenten zuverlässig ihren Schwachstellen zuordnen. Jede Komponente hat Identifier nach den Standards PURL oder CPE. Du verbesserst, wie wir über diese Identifier die passenden Schwachstellen finden. Du arbeitest dabei mit Python, Dependency-Track und den Schwachstellendatenbanken NVD und OSV. Ziel: Minimierung von übersehenen Schwachstellen und Fehlalarmen. 2. Schwachstellenberichte, die im Alltag helfen. Du entwickelst ein Konzept für unsere Berichte. Wer liest sie? Welcher Inhalt und welche Form nützen jeder Zielgruppe am meisten? Qualifikation Das bringst Du mit Du studierst Informatik oder ein ähnliches Fach. Du magst die Programmiersprache Python. Du interessierst Dich für Software-Sicherheit und Schwachstellenmanagement. Wissen zu SBOMs, CVEs oder Dependency-Track ist ein Plus, aber keine Bedingung. Du arbeitest selbstständig und fragst nach, wenn Du nicht weiterkommst. Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch auf Niveau C2. Deine Erklärungen und Argumentationen sind klar und verständlich, auch bei sehr technischen und komplexen Sachverhalten. Du hast mindestens 15 Stunden pro Woche Zeit. Benefits Das bieten wir Remote-Arbeit innerhalb Deutschlands und freie Zeiteinteilung. Überdurchschnittliche Bezahlung. Dein Stundenlohn steigt mit Deiner Produktivität. Wir wollen Dich nach dem Studium gern in Vollzeit übernehmen. So arbeiten wir Wir arbeiten mit KI-Agenten wie Claude Code oder Codex. Sie ersetzen unser eigenes Denken nicht, aber sie hebeln bei richtiger Anwendung unsere Fähigkeiten. Bewerbung Start: ab sofort. Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze dazu, wie Du die beschriebenen Aufgaben angehen würdest. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

descriptionAr: Du hast einen Hund, ein Smartphone und redest gerne in die Kamera? Dann verdiene von zu Hause aus Geld, flexibel und ohne Creator-Erfahrung. Einen Account mit tausenden Followern brauchst du dafür nicht. Wir zeigen dir, wie es geht. Wir bei BodyFokus sind der Longevity-Lebensbegleiter für Mensch und Hund. Mit PetFokus helfen wir Hunden und ihren Menschen im DACH-Raum, gesund und fit zu bleiben. Für unsere Werbung auf Instagram, Facebook und TikTok suchen wir Hundebesitzer:innen, die authentische, natürliche Videos mit ihrem Hund aufnehmen, so wie man sie von echten Kundinnen und Kunden kennt. Du bekommst ein klares Briefing, nimmst dein Video zu Hause auf und schickst es uns. Mehr nicht. Aufgaben Kurze Videos (ca. 60-180 Sekunden) mit deinem Smartphone zu Hause aufnehmen, gemeinsam mit deinem Hund Nach unserem Briefing und Skript direkt in die Kamera sprechen, natürlich und in deinen eigenen Worten PetFokus-Produkte bei deinem Hund vorstellen und zeigen, wie du sie im Alltag einsetzt Videos ungeschnitten bei uns einreichen (den Schnitt übernehmen wir) Bei Bedarf ein Video nach unserem Feedback noch einmal aufnehmen Dein Zeitaufwand liegt bei ca. 1,5 Stunden pro Werktag. Du teilst dir die Zeit frei ein. Qualifikation Worauf es uns ankommt: Du hast einen Hund und kennst ihn gut. Er muss kein Profi vor der Kamera sein, aber entspannt genug, dass du mit ihm filmen kannst. Du wirkst vor der Kamera sympathisch und natürlich. Perfekt sein musst du nicht. Du sprichst klar und verständlich Deutsch. Du hast ein aktuelles Smartphone und einen ruhigen Ort mit gutem Licht. Du bist zuverlässig und hältst Absprachen ein. Du bist offen für Feedback und nimmst Videos auch mal ein zweites Mal auf. Schnitt- oder Technikkenntnisse brauchst du nicht. Erfahrung mit Social Media oder Videos ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Du interessierst dich für Hundegesundheit und möchtest, dass es deinem Hund langfristig gut geht. Benefits Minijob mit 603 € im Monat, ganz bequem von zu Hause aus Flexible Zeiteinteilung, keine festen Arbeitszeiten Du bekommst die PetFokus-Produkte für deinen Hund von uns Auf Wunsch stellen wir dir ein Handy-Mikro zur Verfügung Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen, das dich unterstützt und ehrliches Feedback gibt Wichtig zu wissen: Wir nutzen die Videos als Werbung. Dafür räumst du uns die entsprechenden Nutzungsrechte ein. Die Details regeln wir transparent im Vertrag. Schick uns einfach ein kurzes Video von dir und deinem Hund (ca. 30 Sekunden, mit dem Handy aufgenommen), in dem ihr euch vorstellt. Mehr brauchen wir nicht. Wir freuen uns auf euch! descriptionAr: Menschen im Erleben zusammenbringen ist unsere Leidenschaft. Für den nächsten Schritt suchen wir einen Vollzeit Geschäftsführer idealerweise mit e-Commerece Hintergrund, der unsere Skalierung in die 10 Mio. € Umsatz vorantreibt. Aufgaben Als Geschäftsführer leitest du unser 12 köpfiges Team im Backoffice und über 300 Guides, von der Marktexpansion über die Organisation unserer Events bis zum Ausbau neuer Geschäftsfelder, wir als Gesellschafter und Gründer stehen mit Rat und Tat zur Seite. Unser ambitionierter Wachstumsplan über weitere Märkte und das Wachstum der Standorte führt dich in neue Erlebnisse, Geschäftsfelder zwischen Tourismus, Ecommerce und Erlebnisindustrie. Qualifikation Wir suchen jemanden mit unternehmerischem Mindset, der Herrausforderungen frühzeitig selbstständig erkennt, Freude hat strukturiert, fokusiert zu arbeiten und den Wildschytz weiter erfolgreich zu entwickeln. Hands-On-Mentalität: Du packst, wenn nötig, selbst an und hast keine Angst, dir die Hände schmutzig zu machen. Aktuelle Tech-Kompetenz: Du bleibst am Zahn der Zeit: Shopify, Zapier, AI Agents, Google Workspace sind keine Fremdworte für dich. Idealerweise E-Commerce Hintergrund: Meta Ads, Google Ads, Creatives, CAC's, ROAS und co. sind dir keine Fremdwörter. Strukturiert: GuV, Buchhaltung, Reporting bereitest du gewissenhaft vor und kommunizierst Abweichungen proaktiv. All-in: Du brennst für dieses Unternehmen, vor allem anderen und exklusiv, Nebentätigkeiten sind nicht vorgesehen. Dafür bist du investiert in unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg. Benefits Du steigst in ein laufendes Unternehmen mit siebenstelligen Umsätzen ein und profitierst von unserem starken Know-how. Deine Chance: Übernimm als Geschäftsführer (gn) die Verantwortung und werde langfristig am Erfolg beteiligt. Gehaltspaket bestehend aus Basisgehalt (bis zu 50k€) und Gewinnbeteiligung (33%). Attraktive Gewinnbeteiligung von 33% (bei weiterem Unternehmenswachstum). Umsetzungsspielraum: Als Geschäftsführer entscheidest du, wie du die Ziele des Unternehmens in der Umsetzung erreichst. Full-Remote: Grundsätzlich Full-Remote, nur in der Einarbeitungszeit (6 Monate) treffen wir uns einmal in der Woche Freitags für einen gemeinsamen Arbeitstag in Heidelberg/Karlsruhe. Persönliche Weiterentwicklung: Du hast direkten Zugriff auf Tobias und Fabian, unser Netzwerk der Unternehmensgruppe, sowie Rat und Tat für deine Rolle. Wir freuen uns über eine aussagekräftige Bewerbung, die deinen Fit für die Rolle zeigt. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

descriptionAr: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.   Senior Product Designer, Knowledge Graph This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the US and Canada (East Coast US/Canada preferred, open to other time zones for exceptional candidates) . The Opportunity: As a Senior Product Designer at Grafana Labs, you will join a growing Product Design organization of more than 25 designers, researchers, engineers, and design leaders distributed across six continents. You will work within a 100% remote R&D organization, so strong, proactive remote communication, collaboration, facilitation, and relationship building skills will be essential to your success. As  Senior Product Designer for Grafana Cloud’s Knowledge Graph , you'll design experiences for the context layer of Grafana Cloud that powers our entity graph, entity catalog and RCA workbench. Knowledge Graph automatically discovers services, infrastructure, and databases from the telemetry teams already have, maps how they depend on each other, and runs anomaly detection. This gives engineers, SREs, and their agents an up to date picture of their systems. We want anyone to be able to understand a system and resolve an incident faster, without writing queries or maintaining alert rules, not just the one person who happens to know it best. Over time, you will develop deep expertise in your product area and associated customer and user personas, use cases, and workflows, which will enable you to design tailored, role-driven experiences. You will also have an opportunity to contribute to the evolution of the Product Design team at Grafana by coaching and mentoring other designers, collaborating on team internal initiatives, and helping evolve new ways of working, learning, and having fun together as the team scales. What You’ll Be Doing: Enabling customers to easily understand and explore how their systems connect to each other. Find clear, simple ways to show complex, constantly-changing information without overwhelming the user Translate research and data to experiences that are easy to digest and break down complexity Tailor the experience to different target audiences, covering multiple user perspectives Work cross-functionally with peers and leaders in engineering, product management, technical writing, and GTM functions, as well as other members of the Product Design team Prioritise for delivering impact while balancing business priorities, customer wishes and technical considerations  Document user needs and pain points, design directions, UX trade-offs, and detailed designs for specific features and enhancements Execute research and contribute to quantitative and qualitative research initiatives with researchers, cross-functional collaborators, customers, and members of the Grafana user community What Makes You a Great Fit: 7+ years of relevant design experience working on B2B/enterprise software products, ideally designing tools and services for developers or other highly technical users A portfolio of effective designs for complex products delivered in a fast-paced environment Experience running qualitative research in complex fields, building empathy with users and humans, their needs and pain points even when you have very little in common with them Ability to make design decisions that appropriately balance business goals, product priorities, customer feedback, research insights, and technical considerations Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple locations and time-zones to iteratively ship and evolve products while keeping the end design vision in mind Attention to detail and willingness to learn about a complex, very technical product space Experience working in a fully-remote, fast-paced environment where you are expected to share openly, default to transparency, and embrace your autonomy Bonus Points For: Experience designing complex, data-dense interfaces with a focus on clarity Ability to rapidly gain an understanding of a technical domain and associated customer needs and user workflows in order to design effective experiences within that domain Domain knowledge or experience related to observability, cloud infrastructure, and/or database monitoring Experience helping design teams, especially at engineering led companies, level up their practice, collaboration with partner functions, and user and organizational impact When you apply, please: Provide an example of an experience where decision-making in a complex area is made easy through a well-curated UI. Add a sentence or two about what you believe makes it effective. Compensation & Rewards: In Canada, the Base compensation

descriptionAr: Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the Role At Camunda, we're transforming the way enterprises orchestrate AI and automate their most critical business processes—and we're just getting started. As a Corporate Account Executive, you'll join a fast-growing sales team and be at the forefront of helping mid-sized organizations break through the automation ceiling by orchestrating AI agents, people, and systems at scale. We're witnessing a pivotal moment: enterprises are deploying AI agents faster than ever, but they're struggling to coordinate them safely and achieve end-to-end outcomes. That's where Camunda comes in. You'll work with curious, collaborative, and highly motivated people who believe in doing great work without ego. This is a role where your contributions will have a visible impact—not only on your customers' success, but on how they operationalize AI across their entire organization. This is product work with real trade-offs — pedagogical, technical, and business — and you're accountable for how it lands, not just how it looks. Beyond Curriculum, you'd set the illustration and motion bar for all of Miaplaza: the standards, motion principles, and character direction that the other designers and the design system build from. A defining part of the role is art-directing AI-assisted production. You'd build the prompts, references, and review process that let a small team produce quality illustration and motion at a scale hand-crafting alone can't reach. We don't expect you to know every current tool — we expect the taste and judgment to direct output rather than accept defaults. You'd report to the Head of UX, with regular 1:1s covering craft, product, and career growth. The direction is upward: deeper craft leadership, cross-product influence, or both. Strategische Beratung zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung des betrieblichen Arbeits- und Gesundheitsschutzes. Analyse von Betriebsunfällen sowie Ableitung geeigneter Maßnahmen zur nachhaltigen Unfallverhütung. Entwicklung individueller und praxisorientierter Konzepte, abgestimmt auf die Anforderungen unserer Kunden. Einbringung eigener Ideen zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung unseres Beratungs- und Leistungsangebots. Kunden- und Projektmanagement: Verantwortung für eine strukturierte, verlässliche und partnerschaftliche Betreuung der betreuten Kunden. Eigenständige Koordination von Projekten, Terminen und vereinbarten Maßnahmen. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Kolleg:innen aus Arbeitsmedizin, Gesundheitsmanagement und Psychologie sowie weiteren internen Fachbereichen. descriptionAr: Your creative field We are looking for a full-time , permanent Web Developer (all genders) to start as soon as possible . We live remote-first within Germany , but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations. What makes a good web developer? Not just that they code beautifully – but that they also know everything is still running at 3 a.m. Here, you work according to the "you build it, you run it" principle: full ownership, a modern tech stack, and AI-assisted development that lets you actively shape the architecture of our website. That's exactly who we're looking for. Not a developer who hands off their code and then watches what happens to it, but someone who builds it, runs it, and stands behind it. For us, "you build it, you run it" isn't a saying that sounds nice – it's everyday reality: you write a feature, test it, push it live, and if something wobbles afterward, you're the one who sets it straight again. Not because no one else is around, but because you know best what you built. No blame game, no ticket disappearing into another team's queue, no "that's not my problem anymore" – real ownership, from the first commit to stable operation in production. What does that look like in practice? On a typical day, you work on new features for our website, often supported by AI-assisted, agentic coding – not as a gimmick, but as a completely normal tool in your everyday work. You exchange ideas with the team, bring your own thinking to the architecture, and help make decisions rather than just implementing specs. You deploy through continuous delivery, keep an eye on how your code behaves in production, and when something isn't running smoothly, you dig into it yourself instead of waiting for someone else to. You work with a modern stack (Astro, SvelteKit, TypeScript) and have the freedom to actively shape the architecture of our website – not as a bystander, but as someone whose fingerprints are visible in the end result. We're not interested in celebrating process for its own sake; what matters to us is that good ideas find their way into production quickly: short paths, a lot of trust, and little bureaucracy. What convinces us Your personality, paired with: 3–5 years of hands-on experience in web development (agency or in-house) Strong, proven expertise with Astro, SvelteKit (SSG & SSR) and TypeScript Experience with headless CMS (ideally PayloadCMS), Git and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab) Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (e.g. Claude, OpenCode) and an AI-forward mindset Fluent German and English IT-related education/degree or equivalent practical experience A "you build it, you run it" mentality, paired with strong ownership and reliability Strong analytical skills, clear goal- and results-orientation, and a genuine customer-first mindset Team spirit, strong communication skills, and openness to change Nice to have: Kubernetes, Docker, agile development processes, and terminal power-user skills (Neovim, tmux) We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference. Awesome Prospects At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference. What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint. Additionally, we offer: Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and thousands of fitness and wellness facilities Enjoy exclusive perks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program Recharge your energy – 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve Give back – An extra day off to get involved in social activities through our Volunteer Day Make an impact – Take ownership and bring your ideas to life with real creative freedom Keep growing – Individual professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative tech environment Feel comfortable where you work – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity Create lasting memories – Company events and team activities you won’t forget How to reach us If you have any questions, you can reach out to Alina by phone +49 89 2441067714. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. About the Role As a Customer Support Engineer , youʼll be on the front lines of our customer experience. Youʼll work directly with customers to quickly triage issues, debug problems, and ensure theyʼre getting the most out of HappyRobotʼs AI platform. This role is a hybrid between technical support and customer engineering: youʼll diagnose issues, design and test quick solutions, and collaborate closely with both engineering and product teams to make our platform even stronger. Youʼll also apply prompt engineering skills to help customers fine-tune their AI workers, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and speed across real-world logistics workflows. This role is ideal for someone with strong technical fundamentals who wants to grow into a more senior customer engineering or product-facing position over time. Tech Profile Comfortable Full-Stack: Python, React, TypeScript, Node.js. Experience managing APIs and integrations with third-party systems. Some exposure to infrastructure and cloud deployments. Fluency in both English and Japanese.

This work spans all of the company's medical devices, across the main radiology modalities: X-Ray, CT, MRI, and Mammography. Ensure compliance with Quality and Regulatory requirements throughout the development cycle, including technical documentation (e.g. implementation specs), cybersecurity processes, and risk analysis. Collaborate with the team on strategic recommendations and improvements to technology and business. Other functions may be assigned, and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time. Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in a related field such as computer science, biomedical engineering or similar (required). Experience (required): at least 5 years of experience in a similar or related relevant role At least 5 years of experience working with Java, with proficiency in Spring Boot (required). Fluent in English (required). Accustomed to CI/CD practice (required). Familiar with test-driven development and testing frameworks like JUnit (required). Experience working with docker, cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS, and Kubernetes (required). Experience working with Agentic Coding tools like Claude and Cursor (preferred). Experience working with microservices and distributed systems (preferred). Experience in the MedTech field, e.g. working with DICOM data, AI algorithms, and clinical workflows (preferred). What we value Strong analytical mindset. Not afraid of working inside a strong regulatory framework and disciplined about testing needs. Ability to make well-reasoned trade-offs between velocity and quality, understanding when to work for higher quality and when to optimize for time-to-market. You collaborate openly, support your colleagues, and contribute to shared success. Quality Standards Communicate, cooperate, and consistently function professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors. Demonstrate initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercise confidentiality in all areas of performance. Follow all local, regional, and country laws concerning employment. Follow all DeepHealth policies and procedures. Follow data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times. Practice universal safety precautions. Promote good public relations on the phone and in person. Adapt and willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems. Report to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meals and rest breaks, and maintain satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines. Complete job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner. Travel This position requires domestic / international travel up to 10%. Working Environment Hybrid, remote-friendly Based in France (we have offices in Paris and Grenoble) or in the Netherlands (we have offices in Rotterdam and Amsterdam) Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

As an engineer on the team, you will focus on building new functionality into our APIs and distributed code while ensuring the performance and reliability of our services which ingest millions of data points each day. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role As a Technical Recruiter, you'll help GitLab build the engineering and product teams behind our DevSecOps platform. In this individual contributor role, you'll partner with leaders across Engineering, Product, Security, and UX and own searches from intake through close. You'll build inclusive pipelines and use data and market insight to guide hiring decisions, while growing into a trusted talent advisor. What you'll do Manage full-cycle searches for roles such as Backend and Frontend Engineers, Site Reliability Engineers, Security Engineers, Data Engineers, Engineering Managers, and Product Managers, delivering against agreed recruiting goals and key metrics with accurate, timely documentation in Greenhouse. Lead intake and kickoff conversations to align hiring teams on role scope, technical requirements, team context, interview plans, and timelines, with senior team guidance as needed. Partner with hiring teams on structured, equitable technical interviews with clear competencies and actionable feedback; challenge assumptions and escalate risks or blockers early. Use talent-market research, compensation benchmarks, funnel metrics, and candidate feedback to shape search strategy and address hiring issues. Assess technical candidates on depth of experience, scope and impact of past work, problem-solving, and open source or community contributions, and how well their skills fit GitLab's teams and technology. Build research-based, diversity-focused sourcing plans that balance applicants, passive talent, referrals, internal talent, and targeted outreach across technical communities and specialized talent pools. Deliver a thoughtful candidate experience through disciplined pipeline management, proactive communication, timely feedback, and offer negotiations that clearly explain compensation, equity, and benefits. Improve recruiting practices by sharing learnings and reusable resources, using artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly, and representing GitLab's mission, values, and culture. What you'll bring Intermediate-level recruiting experience, with a track record of owning full-cycle searches independently. Technical recruiting experience, or a strong interest in learning engineering and product disciplines, tech stacks, team structures, and how software is built and shipped. Developing advisor skills: building stakeholder trust, influencing without authority, and managing hiring team expectations. Experience building proactive, diversity-focused sourcing strategies and balanced pipelines for hard-to-fill or specialized roles. A data-informed approach that turns funnel insights into practical actions. Strong organization across multiple requisitions and clear written and verbal communication across time zones, with attention to detail and candidate care. Experience with an applicant tracking system and recruiting tools such as Greenhouse, LinkedIn Recruiter, LinkedIn Insights, SeekOut, or comparable platforms; ability to evaluate AI-generated work, protect confidential information, and share responsible workflows with team members. Experience recruiting for DevSecOps, developer tools, or open source software is helpful, not required. About the team We work in a globally distributed, remote-first Talent Acquisition team where clear communication and reliable follow-through matter. Our team members share learnings and create reusable resources to improve the quality and consistency of hiring across Research & Development. How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being Flexible Paid Time Off  Team Member Resource Groups Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan Growth and Development Fund Parental Leave   Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application. Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. Improve recruiting practices by sharing learnings and reusable resources, using artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly, and representing GitLab's mission, values, and culture. Sales or go-to-market recruiting experience, or a strong interest in learning sales segments, quotas, OTE, ramp time, territory design, and sales cycles. descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI Finance ensures the organization is positioned for long-term success as we pursue our mission. The Revenue team plays a critical role in enabling OpenAI to scale commercial offerings by overseeing billing operations, deal desk, revenue systems, revenue accounting, and controllership. We work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Go-To-Market, Tax, Legal, and Technical Accounting to support new monetization strategies, improve operational efficiency, and maintain financial integrity as the business grows. About the Role This senior leader will own key elements of Ads revenue accounting from technical assessment through operational execution. The role will guide accounting for products, pricing, contracts, incentives, credits, refunds, makegoods, international expansion, and new go-to-market motions. It will establish governance and translate approved accounting positions into launch, billing, data, close, reconciliation, and control requirements. Success requires deep technical revenue expertise, strong business partnership, and the ability to build durable 0-to-1 processes in a fast-changing environment. Advertising is a critical and growing monetization vector for OpenAI, and this role will help shape the financial foundations that enable Ads to scale responsibly and transparently. This role can be based in San Francisco or New York City. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: Lead technical accounting assessments for Ads products and commercial arrangements, including performance obligations, variable consideration, allocation, principal-versus-agent, collectibility, contract modifications, refunds, incentives, credits, makegoods, and revenue presentation. Own and continuously evolve Ads revenue accounting policies and operating guidance as product behavior, pricing, contracting, incentive programs, and billing models change. Establish governance for new products and accounting decisions, including intake, decision rights, materiality and escalation thresholds, launch approvals, policy versioning, decision logs, and post-launch monitoring. Translate accounting conclusions into clear requirements for product design, contracting, billing, data, estimates, close, reconciliations, controls, and reporting. Own the operating cadence for incentive and makegood accounting, invoice readiness, accruals and reserves, settlements, reconciliations, GL tie-outs, flux analysis, reporting, and control evidence. Partner with Ads Product, Engineering, Data, Finance Engineering, Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, Tax, Billing, and Technical Accounting on launches, enterprise negotiations, and international expansion. Prepare concise technical memos and audit-ready support; align novel or material conclusions with Corporate Technical Accounting and external auditors. Use data, AI, and automation to improve research, monitoring, policy maintenance, issue tracking, documentation, and repeatable Finance workflows with appropriate review controls. You might thrive in this role if you have: 10+ years of progressive experience in revenue accounting, including direct ownership of complex ASC 606 judgments and operational execution. Demonstrated leadership to independently set direction, prioritize across competing risks, and influence senior cross-functional stakeholders. Experience with digital advertising, adtech, marketplaces, payments, usage-based services, or another high-volume transaction environment. Strong command of variable consideration, principal-versus-agent, contract modifications, incentives and credits, collectibility, estimates, and revenue presentation. Track record building 0-to-1 accounting processes, governance, close mechanisms, reconciliations, and controls that scale. Ability to turn technical conclusions into practical product, contract, billing, data, and operating requirements. Clear, concise written and executive communication, including audit-ready documentation and evidence-based recommendations. Preferred Qualifications: Experience supporting global launches, multiple currencies, international contracting entities, intercompany considerations, or localized billing models. Experience applying AI or automation within Finance while maintaining review, validation, and control standards. Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data, or Finance systems teams. Experience developing or leading high-performing accounting teams or distributed operating groups. Background in public-company controllership, technical accounting, audit, or similarly rigorous control environments. descriptionAr: About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. About the Role As a Strategic Account Manager, you will be responsible for driving the strategy, growth, and overall health of a book of 8–12 of Ramp’s largest and most strategic customers. You’ll own the long-term relationship and be accountable for maintaining and growing revenue, driving product adoption, and ensuring your customers achieve meaningful business outcomes on Ramp. You’ll build deep relationships across all levels of your customers’ organizations, from day-to-day operators to C-suite executives, and be skilled at managing complex stakeholder dynamics and product configurations. Internally, you’ll partner closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams at Ramp to strengthen our B2B relationships, coordinate strategic initiatives, and feed structured insights into our product roadmap and internal processes. What You’ll Do Own a portfolio of 8–12 strategic Enterprise customers, with clear accountability for retention, expansion, and overall account health Maintain and grow revenue and usage within your book of business by identifying, pitching, and executing on upsell and cross-sell opportunities Build and execute detailed account and territory plans, including QBRs and executive reviews that highlight results, surface risks, and align on future growth Lead frequent customer conversations (status calls, roadmap discussions, upsell conversations, and QBRs) to ensure customers are achieving strong outcomes with Ramp Own end-to-end execution of renewals and expansions, from discovery and solution design through commercial negotiation and close Serve as a Ramp product expert, proactively uncovering workflow gaps and recommending solutions that save customers time and money, while guiding them toward deeper platform adoption Partner cross-functionally with Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, CSMs, and Solutions to coordinate customer initiatives and deliver tailored, enterprise-grade solutions Provide structured feedback to product and leadership teams, translating customer needs and patterns into recommendations that shape Ramp’s Strategic and Enterprise roadmap Navigate and align internal and external stakeholders, including C-suite executives, investors, partners, and cross-functional teams Use data and analytics to inform your strategy, monitor account performance, and communicate impact and opportunities in a clear, grounded way What You Need 9+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or a similar revenue-focused role 3+ years managing strategic Enterprise accounts (2,500+ employees or Fortune 1000) with proven commercial ownership Strong familiarity with Fintech, Payments, Finance/Accounting, or B2B SaaS products Demonstrated success negotiating and closing complex six-figure renewals and upsells Ability to understand and communicate complex product workflows, integrations, and technical configurations High fluency in financial value drivers — able to articulate ROI, payback periods, process modernization, and cost savings Deep sense of ownership with the ability to build processes, playbooks, and documentation from 0→1 as strategic customers push the limits of Ramp’s platform and require new, scalable solutions Strong executive communication and storytelling skills with the ability to influence cross-functionally and at the C-suite Consistent track record of hitting or exceeding revenue targets in fast-paced descriptionAr: About the Role As Enterprise Sales Manager, Cyber, you will build and lead a team of Account Directors focused on strategic growth with leading cyber companies and enterprise security organizations. Your team will help customers apply OpenAI’s platform to their products and internal workflows while navigating the security, privacy, and governance requirements of deploying AI at scale. You’ll coach the team through complex sales cycles involving security, product, engineering, legal, procurement, and executive stakeholders. You’ll also help shape our approach to this evolving market, turning early adoption into lasting customer partnerships. In this role, you will: Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing team of Enterprise Account Directors. Coach senior sellers through deal reviews, account planning, customer meetings, and structured 1:1s. Define the cyber go-to-market strategy, including customer segmentation, account prioritization, partner opportunities, executive engagement, and territory planning. Drive pipeline generation, forecast accuracy, and strong operating discipline. Guide complex opportunities involving CISOs, security leaders, product and engineering teams, legal, risk, procurement, and executives. Help customers identify measurable ways to apply AI across security products and workflows, including analyst productivity, investigations, incident response, and software security. Partner with Product, Solutions Architecture, Technical Success, Legal, Security, Finance, and policy experts to support responsible deployment. Share customer feedback on product needs, integration blockers, data protection and governance requirements, and emerging cyber use cases. You might thrive in this role if you have: 15+ years of enterprise sales, GTM, or sales leadership experience, including substantial experience in cyber. A proven track record building and scaling teams responsible for large, complex strategic accounts and significant revenue targets. Deep understanding of how cyber companies and enterprise security teams evaluate, buy, deploy, and expand technical platforms. Experience building new go-to-market motions and growing adoption beyond initial deployments. The ability to coach senior sellers through long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. Technical fluency across APIs, cloud and enterprise architecture, data platforms, AI/ML concepts, and security buying requirements. Strong operating rigor across forecasting, pipeline health, territory planning, and performance management. Executive presence and a low-ego, collaborative leadership style. Experience with consumption-based platforms, AI-enabled security products, or public-company sales operations is a plus. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Unlike traditional Solutions Architects or consultants, you will write production code, shape technical architecture, and directly influence how Cloudflare products are used at massive scale. You will operate as a technical extension of both organizations - helping the customer ship faster while surfacing real-world product insights back to Cloudflare engineering. Platform Advocacy & Adoption: Identify opportunities to accelerate the adoption of Cloudflare services, unlocking new capabilities across the customer’s tech stack. Platform Breadth & Depth : Deep technical competence in building production applications on a modern stack, combined with the willingness and ability to go deep on all Cloudflare product areas. From Workers to security, networking, and observability. Feedback Loop & Product Influence: Surface real-world edge cases and product gaps directly to Cloudflare’s Product and Engineering teams to influence the developer platform roadmap. Strategic Relationship Management: Establish and maintain trusted technical relationships with senior leadership (Staff+ engineers, Directors, and VPs). On-Site Presence: Maintain a regular on-site presence at customer locations to foster deep collaboration and cultural alignment. descriptionAr: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role In healthcare, the phone is still the front door, and call volume keeps rising while the people answering it are harder to hire and keep. You'll own our North America enterprise motion across providers, payers, and life sciences, helping health organizations put agents in front of patients, members, and clinicians that are safe, fast, and fit the systems they already run. You'll have the mandate to build the playbook and the team. In this role, you will: Own the enterprise healthcare function across health systems, payers, and pharma/medtech: strategy, pipeline, forecast, process, execution Define the enterprise ICP, sales methodology, and a repeatable motion for each segment Build and lead a high-performing enterprise sales team Land and expand with large health systems, health plans, and life sciences companies Work through BAAs, security review, and AI governance boards (and MLR review for pharma), starting compliance conversations in week one Partner with our Forward Deployed Engineers to scope integrations with the EHR, claims, and telephony systems customers already run Help customers pick one high-volume starting point (scheduling, reminders, after-hours coverage, benefits and claims status, HCP support) and prove it before scaling Build a reference network of healthcare peers that buyers can call Lead executive briefings, events, and high-stakes negotiations Bring a sharp view of the competitive landscape, including build-vs-buy, platform bundlers, and vertical point solutions, to positioning and strategy Set the bar for sales culture, integrity, and customer-first execution Requirements: Proven enterprise sales leadership in a high-growth, product-led tech company (AI/ML strongly preferred) Track record selling to health systems, payers, or life sciences, with fluency in HIPAA, BAAs, and long, multi-stakeholder cycles Experience building and scaling sales teams from the ground up Seven-figure enterprise deals and complex sales cycles Ability to be strategic and hands-on at once Executive presence at C-suite and board levels Collaborative, humble, and driven Passion for the transformative potential of conversational AI Remote-first in the United States, with a strong preference for New York or San Francisco, where we have office spaces. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses. About the role We're hiring a Direct Tax Lead to own our US income tax provision, compliance, and controls, reporting to the Head of Tax. ElevenLabs operates through its US entity and ~9 international entities and is growing fast, which means the provision, the compliance calendar, and the controls around them need a dedicated owner. This is a hands-on ownership role. The provision and returns are prepared by external providers; you manage those engagements and are accountable for the output. You'll own the quarterly and annual ASC 740 provision (deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, rate rec, footnote disclosures), the US federal and state compliance calendar (returns, extensions, estimated payments), and the technical work underneath it: §174 capitalization, §382 and NOL tracking. You'll also assist in designing, documenting, and operating controls, and write the memos that support our positions, working directly with our Big 4 advisors and external auditors alongside the Head of Tax. Requirements Deep ASC 740 expertise at a multinational — provision, deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, rate reconciliation, and footnote disclosure Experience owning a US federal and multistate compliance calendar (returns, extensions, estimates) Working knowledge of US international provisions (NCTI/GILTI, Subpart F, FDDEI, §163(j)) and how they flow into the provision Experience managing Big 4 or equivalent providers and working directly with external auditors Has built or operated SOX controls over tax, or supported a first SOX implementation CPA Bonus: pre-IPO or first-10-K experience, §174/§41 computation, §382 studies, equity compensation tax (ISOs, NSOs, RSUs), OneSource Tax Provision or similar. Growth Potential We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: Build and lead the direct tax team as we bring provision and compliance in-house Expand into other strategic initiatives such as M&A, PE mitigation policy, corporate structuring. Broaden into wider tax leadership as our footprint grows Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere on the east coast, New York preferred. An overview of this role As Director of Engineering, Database Excellence, you will lead the Database Excellence stage and report to the Vice President of Data Engineering, in our Engineering department. You will set the direction for the databases that support GitLab.com, self-managed GitLab, and GitLab Dedicated. Your organization owns the reliability, capacity, health, and sustainability of GitLab's application datastores, with PostgreSQL as the primary focus alongside Redis, OpenSearch, ClickHouse, and object storage. You will be accountable for database capacity and availability on GitLab.com. You will guide long-range platform decisions while partnering with Infrastructure, Product, Distribution, Support, Security, and FinOps. The work includes reducing infrastructure costs, improving data growth controls and saturation detection, standardizing database services, rebuilding the self-managed upgrade experience, and contributing to GitLab's company-wide datastore strategy, including Cells partitioning. Learn more in the Database Excellence handbook . What you’ll do Set direction and long-range plans for the database platform in line with company strategy. Own database capacity and availability outcomes for GitLab.com, and communicate database risk to senior leadership. Lead and coach three Engineering Managers and develop Staff-plus engineers into leaders. Drive cross-division technical decisions using data, partnering with Infrastructure, Product, Distribution, Support, Security, and FinOps. Partner with Product to prioritize database platform investments and make infrastructure tradeoffs in the context of product outcomes. Own the hiring plan, organization design, retention, and performance management for teams across regions. Set quarterly objectives and key results and engineering key performance indicators for the stage, and manage the database infrastructure budget with FinOps. Serve as an escalation point for database incidents, standardize effective processes, and keep the handbook current. What you’ll bring Experience leading managers of managers, including coaching newer managers. Experience working hands-on with PostgreSQL at scale, including capacity planning, upgrades, replication, performance, and large production clusters. Experience using data to make strategic technical decisions and connect database platform investments and tradeoffs with product outcomes. Experience supporting software that customers run themselves, or working through the self-managed upgrade challenge. Experience leading backend engineering teams that own production infrastructure, applying site reliability engineering practices including service level objectives, on-call operations, incident management, cost management, and automation. Experience communicating clearly in writing in an asynchronous, handbook-first company. Experience leading globally distributed remote teams. Experience with Redis, ClickHouse, OpenSearch, object storage, Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Terraform, Chef, managed database services, FinOps, AI-assisted engineering workflows, or platform and infrastructure organizations is a plus. About the team Database Excellence includes Database Architecture, Database Automation, and Self Managed Database. Three Engineering Managers lead these teams, alongside an Operations Manager. Our teams work across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and India. Database Architecture provides datastore guidance, data growth controls, and the database review process. Database Automation builds PostgreSQL fleet automation, upgrades, provisioning, health monitoring, and an internal managed PostgreSQL offering. Self Managed Database is rebuilding the upgrade and migration experience for self-managed GitLab. Together, we make database services more reliable, sustainable, and easier to operate across GitLab's deployment models. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Toronto, Ontatio About the Department The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.  Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences.  What you'll do You'll drive new business by identifying and qualifying target commercial accounts in Ontario for Cloudflare’s Enterprise service plan. This is a great opportunity for a Sales Professional to help build the business in Central Canada. You will have both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive customer engagement from technical professionals through to senior executive levels, and across Security, Network, Development and Infrastructure teams.   Responsibilities Develop and execute against a comprehensive account/territory plan Increase sales in a defined territory and/or account list to achieve revenue targets Create and articulate compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services Manage contract negotiations Maintain a robust sales pipeline Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts Ensure customer satisfaction Develop and maintain partner relationships as it relates to customer base Requirements Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience Minimum 5 years of direct technical sales experience Experience selling solutions related to Cyber Security, Networking, Cloud Solutions, SaaS, IaaS, PaaS is a plus   Mid to advanced understanding of computer networking and “how the internet works” Aptitude for learning complex technical concepts/terms (technical background in engineering, computer science, or IT strongly desired) Strong interpersonal communication (verbal and written) and organizational skills Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit Comfortable working in a fast paced, dynamic environment What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard

descriptionAr: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role Like other managers at GitLab, you'll see your team as your product. You'll spend your time hiring and developing world-class Support Engineers who deliver exceptional technical support while continuously improving how your team solves problems. GitLab is working through it’s own AI transformation so you’ll be a leader in designing and implementing AI strategy for our Support team. As a Support Manager, you shape the customer support experience in your region. You'll balance direct customer relationships with the work of scaling your team, improving internal processes, adopting AI, and collaborating across departments to ship tools and solutions that make support more efficient. You'll help your team become self-sufficient, take ownership of complex issues from initial contact through resolution, and create a psychologically safe environment where people grow. Some examples of our projects: A tool to automatically check a GitLab Omnibus install for known issues A solution that captures the state of a customer's server for easier troubleshooting A tool that turns log files into interactive tables so you can easily sort and filter columns Functionality for ChatOps that makes it easier to identify user accounts on the GitLab.com platform What you’ll do Partner with other support managers to hire and maintain a world-class Support Engineering team focused on delivering excellent technical support to GitLab's customers. Develop your team members' technical skills and experience through mentorship, structured training, and career growth opportunities. Drive team ownership by fostering self-sufficiency, accountability, and alignment with key performance indicators. Build scalable processes and workflows that enable your team to collaborate effectively and execute with excellence. Conduct regular 1:1s with all team members to support their growth, address challenges, and create psychological safety. Train Support Engineers to conduct high-quality technical interviews, strengthening your hiring pipeline. Partner across GitLab to deepen understanding of customer needs and business goals, informing product and support improvements. Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance the customer experience through measurable, repeatable solutions. Document how the team works and find ways to make it more efficient through tools, process changes, and automation. Use AI well in your own work and coach your team to do the same. What you’ll bring Ability to lead technical, customer-facing teams and support the growth of Support Engineers at different levels through feedback, mentoring, and growth opportunities. Ability to create and implement processes and procedures that improve team efficiency. Ability to provide technical customer support and manage the full support lifecycle, from understanding customer needs and initial engagement through resolution, in collaboration with development. Analytical and problem-solving skills to troubleshoot complex technical issues and the ability to grow your team’s problem-solving skills. Understanding of Linux System Administration and web application development concepts (with MVC frameworks such as Ruby on Rails, Python, Django, PHP, or Laravel). About the team We are distributed globally across the AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions and own the customer support experience for GitLab. We work on support tickets, dig into code and logs to troubleshoot issues, and collaborate across departments to resolve customer challenges. Our team operates asynchronously with regular pairing sessions, one-on-ones, and Slack conversations that keep us connected. We create an environment where Support Engineers can grow and do their best work. We build processes that balance customer needs with team wellbeing, recognizing that a healthy customer experience comes from a healthy team. For more on how our team works, see the Support team handbook page The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity . Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary. United Stat

descriptionAr: About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. About the Role You will serve as a front-line manager for a team of Enterprise Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) responsible for outbound prospecting and pipeline generation across Ramp’s largest and most strategic accounts. As Ramp expands its upmarket presence, you will help build and evolve the Enterprise go-to-market motion from the ground up. You will lead and develop high-performing SDRs who manage named books of business and navigate complex, multi-threaded enterprise sales cycles. Key responsibilities include coaching and developing SDRs, setting team strategy, and partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and executive leadership to drive enterprise pipeline and business outcomes. As a member of the Sales Leadership team, you will play a critical role in shaping, scaling, and refining Ramp’s Enterprise growth strategy. What You'll Do Build and scale the Enterprise SDR function, including team structure, playbooks, and processes for a named-account motion. Foster a high-performing team culture by managing daily activity, quota attainment, and key performance metrics. Hire, onboard, and train SDRs on Ramp’s products, enterprise buyer personas, competitive landscape, and sales tools. Create and execute career-development and leadership plans for direct reports, including regular 1:1 coaching on time management, objection handling, enterprise prospecting, and active listening. Coach SDRs through complex, multi-threaded enterprise outbound motions, including account research, executive-level messaging, and strategic pipeline generation. Partner with Sales and Marketing to develop and execute initiatives that advance company objectives. Report on team performance and forecast pipeline to senior leadership. Improve team output and efficiency by continuously optimizing systems, processes, and operating rhythms. Represent the Enterprise Sales Development team in cross-functional forums and with leaders across the organization. What You Need At least 2 years of quota-carrying individual-contributor sales experience, with a consistent record of exceeding goals. At least 3 years of experience building and leading sales development teams, with a demonstrated record of exceeding team goals. Success in fast-paced, results-oriented go-to-market environments (ideally within SaaS) and a history of outperforming quota in outbound sales. Experience managing or selling into enterprise accounts with complex, longer sales cycles. A passion for hiring and talent development, with a thoughtful approach to team planning and career growth. Ability to articulate contractual, technical, and financial value propositions to customers, including executive stakeholders. Proficiency with data-analysis tools, as well as familiarity with email and call-automation platforms. Ability to use data to inform decisions, build scalable systems, and identify process improvements that increase conversion and efficiency. An overview of this role GitLab's Deal Desk team partners closely with our Field Organization to support Quoting, Pricing and booking transactions. This team serves as the primary liaison between our Sales & Finance teams and is responsible for the efficient, accurate and timely sales bookings. As part of the larger Revenue Operations team, the Deal Desk team supports our constantly changing and complex business as we launch new products, implement new processes and expand into new countries We're looking for an experienced, dedicated and empathetic leader to manage and grow our EMEA Deal Desk team. Our team is distributed across various European countries, maintaining SLAs and supporting our EMEA sales teams as GitLab's customer base continues to grow.  What you’ll do    Lead the EMEA Deal Desk team, including hiring, enablement, operating rhythm, and ongoing iteration of the function within the region. Own the end-to-end service model for Deal Desk and Order Management across EMEA, ensuring the function scales with the complexity, pace, and control requirements of a fast-growing public company. Solid understanding of SaaS pricing models, including per-seat, tiered, multi-year, and usage-based pricing, and the ability to apply pricing strategy into scalable commercial policy. Working knowledge of bookings policy, revenue recognition principles, audit readiness, and public-company compliance requirements. Strong commercial judgment across direct, channel, private offer, and other non-standard sales motions common in EMEA. Strong communication skills, with the ability to tell a clear story from data, influence stakeholders, and drive alignment in ambiguous situations. A customer-focused, solutions-oriented mindset with strong emotional intelligence and experience leading a regional team through change. descriptionAr: Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code. About the role You embed directly with customer teams as the engineer on the ground: own an outcome, ship a production-grade SpaceXAI system that still runs after you leave, and become the critical technical feedback loop from the field back to product engineering. The work is the project. One week you might take a messy business workflow and put a production agent on it: pick the use case, stand up the architecture, wire it into the customer’s auth, data, and tools, then harden it with evals until the team actually uses it. Another week you might live in a customer’s repo and delivery system and ship an agent-powered path for a migration, a PR review loop, or an incident-to-fix flow, behind tests, review, and rollout rather than in a chat sidebar. Either way, you measure what matters, leave the customer able to operate it, and bring the pattern back as another use case for SpaceXAI. This is not a demo role. You own the work end to end, from the first discovery call through launch, iteration, and post-launch support, and you are responsible for systems that work in the real world. What you’ll do Lead discovery with the customer: orient in their codebases and workflows, find the real bottleneck and the use case worth building, and define clear success metrics Design and ship production agents, AI applications, and coding-agent workflows on Grok and our models, on live business processes and inside the customer’s engineering org Get a first version live in days, then harden it over weeks with rollout, monitoring, and iteration from real usage Own production quality: tracing, evals, debugging model or delivery failures, and latency and cost tradeoffs Build the systems around the model (tools, MCP servers, retrieval, rules, skills, CI gates, and evals) and integrate them into the customer’s auth, data, workflow, and delivery systems; decide when prompting, architecture, data, process, or a model change is the right lever Measure the outcome that matters (revenue, cost, hours saved, error rate, cycle time, escaped defects), not seat adoption Work directly with Staff+, platform, and domain leaders, going deep in their systems while communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results Leave the customer team able to run what you built, and turn what you learn into reusable patterns and improvements to SpaceXAI products You may be a fit if Required You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or data science You write and review production code (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript; other languages welcome) You’ve owned a customer or operator outcome, not just a slide or a prototype, and can turn a fuzzy problem into a scoped, shipped system You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows or agents in production, and debugged real production failures (model, tool, data, pipeline, or delivery path) You’ve handled production reliability: metrics, alerts, safe rollouts, incident response You build end to end: frontend, backend, infra, and prompt iteration You thrive in ambiguity and don’t need a complete spec before you start building You can talk to working engineers and to a VP Nice to have 2+ years in a customer-facing role, leading discovery conversations and being accountable for outcomes for external stakeholders Hands-on depth in several of: agents and tool-calling, eval harnesses, retrieval and context systems, CI/CD or developer platforms, and AI-native coding workflows in a real repo Experience as a forward-deployed, solutions, or platform engineer embedded with customers, or as a founding engineer who owned an AI product end to end
