descriptionAr: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applicants from Canadian EST time zones only.   Senior Software Engineer - Session Replay The Opportunity: The Session Replay squad is building a new Grafana Cloud product that helps our customers to understand what users actually experienced when something goes wrong. Session Replay connects frontend signals (errors, performance, synthetic checks) to concrete session-level evidence, enabling faster and more confident investigation of production issues. This team works at the intersection of: frontend observability, backend data processing and storage at scale, debugging workflows across products, privacy and access control, performance and cost constraints at scale. Session Replay is still early, which means you’ll help shape both what we build and how it fits into Grafana Cloud. A key part of our next phase is evolving the backend architecture of capturing sessions, including a migration toward columnar/analytical solution as a primary storage and query engine for high-volume session data. As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. We are looking for Senior Software Engineers who are passionate about working with data and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Our stack is Golang, Typescript and React, but we build tools for people using many other stacks.  What You’ll Be Doing: As a Senior Software Engineer, you will operate as a technical leader and systems thinker, driving both product direction and architectural evolution, specifically, you will: Own end-to-end technical direction for Session Replay, spanning frontend, backend, and data systems Drive the evolution of our backend architecture, including: Designing systems around columnar/analytical data storage for large-scale session data   Defining data models, ingestion pipelines, and query patterns Lead the design of investigation workflows, connecting replay with logs, metrics, traces and other telemetry across Grafana Cloud Make high-leverage architectural decisions that impact multiple teams and products Partner with teams across Grafana (Frontend Observability, Synthetic Monitoring, Core Grafana) to build cohesive cross-product experiences Engage directly with customers - joining calls, gathering structured feedback, and helping customers instrument and adopt Session Replay successfully.  Improve engineering standards, patterns, and operational practices within the team Mentor engineers and help grow technical leadership within the team Technologies you'll work with: Go (backend services and APIs) Columnar/Analytical data storage (core data storage and querying) Object storage (S3, GCS, Azure Blob Storage) and MySQL  TypeScript / React (user-facing workflows) Grafana ecosystem (Mimir, Loki, Tempo, etc.) We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. What Makes You a Great Fit:  You are comfortable working in a remote-first company ; communication is key. For us, working together means being collaborative, friendly, kind, and respectful . We operate by consensus. You can contribute to a discussion, disagree constructively, and commit to the team’s decision. You are able to communicate design decisions clearly in written and spoken English. Ability to reason about data-intensive systems (ingestion, storage, querying, cost trade-offs) You are comfortable owning features in ambiguous problem spaces . We are a small team, working remotely, on a product that will be used by engineers all over the world – the ability to work on your own is crucial. You have a good understanding of a software development process that takes a user-centered approach . You easily build an understanding of the users’ context and goals which will help you build the right solution with the maximum value. You enjoy working on complex solutions – Grafana is a highly technological solution and has avid followers who rely on it every day and who care deeply about their work

Contribute to shared priorities, provide thoughtful ideas and feedback, and turn successful approaches into practices others can use. About the Role We're looking for a Security Engineer with deep incident response experience to help defend Replit, a fast-moving, cloud-native AI vibe-coding platform. You'll be the person who takes charge when something goes wrong. You'll lead investigations from first signal to root cause, coordinate containment across Security, SRE, and Engineering, and keep stakeholders informed while the incident is moving fast. This isn't a pure responder role. We want a well-rounded security engineer who has run real incidents and wants to make the next one faster. You'll write the scripts, automations, and tooling that take manual work out of triage, evidence collection, and containment. You'll also turn lessons from each incident into better detections, playbooks, and platform hardening. Responsibilities Incident Response Serve as incident commander or technical lead for security incidents, from detection and triage through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review. Coordinate response across Security, SRE, Engineering, Legal, and leadership. Drive decisions under pressure and keep a clear record of actions taken. Communicate incident status, impact, and risk clearly to technical and executive audiences. Participate in and help shape the security on-call rotation. Investigation & Forensics Investigate suspicious activity across cloud infrastructure, containers, identity systems, and application layers using SIEM, Cloud Logging, telemetry, and host and container artifacts. Determine scope, root cause, attacker behavior, and blast radius for confirmed incidents. Quickly assess whether emerging threats (0-days, active exploitation campaigns, bug bounty findings, customer reports) apply to Replit, and whether we're already affected. IR Automation & Tooling Build scripts, automations, and tools (Python, Go, Bash, or directly on Replit) that speed up response, such as automated enrichment, evidence collection, credential and session revocation, workload isolation, and alert triage. Develop and maintain response playbooks and runbooks, and automate them where possible. Integrate response workflows with SIEM, SOAR, ticketing, and chat tooling to cut time-to-contain. Detection & Continuous Improvement Turn incident findings into new or improved detections, logging coverage, and visibility. Lead blameless post-incident reviews and drive remediation items to completion. Run tabletop exercises and simulations to test readiness and find gaps. Required Skills & Experience Proven experience leading or serving as technical lead on security incidents in a cloud or SaaS environment. Strong hands-on investigation skills with SIEM, cloud audit logs, and log-based analysis. Comfortable working through large datasets under time pressure. Proficiency writing production-quality scripts or tools in Python, Go, or Bash for investigation and automation. Solid knowledge of cloud architecture and security, especially Google Cloud Platform (IAM, audit logging, GKE, networking). Working knowledge of Kubernetes and containers, including how to investigate and contain compromised workloads. Understanding of identity systems, SaaS architectures, and common cloud attack paths (credential theft, privilege escalation, supply chain, token abuse). Familiarity with software engineering fundamentals, CI/CD pipelines, and package ecosystems, so you can work effectively with Engineering on code-level fixes. Understanding of IR frameworks and lifecycle (for example NIST 800-61), plus the vulnerability lifecycle and exploitability analysis. Preferred Qualifications Experience building or operating SOAR or other response automation platforms. Digital forensics experience with cloud, Linux hosts, or containers. Experience with threat intelligence, threat hunting, or security research. Experience with bug bounty programs or coordinated vulnerability disclosure. Familiarity with detection-as-code practices and writing detection rules. Experience in fast-paced, cloud-native, or AI/ML-driven environments. Relevant certifications (such as GCIH, GCFA, GCFR), or equivalent hands-on experience. Collaboration: Comfort working across cross-functional teams spanning Security, SRE, Engineering, and Infrastructure. Clear communication: Ability to explain findings, risks, and mitigation strategies to stakeholders at all levels. Ownership mindset: Takes initiative to drive investigations, improvements, and remediations to completion. Continuous learning: Passion for staying up to date on new vulnerabilities, exploit trends, and cloud-native security best practices. descriptionAr: About the role Modal’s Inference Runtime team owns the container runtime stack used to run inference and training workloads across our fleet. We work at the boundary of Linux, containers, filesystems, storage, GPU drivers, and distributed systems.Our goal is to make demanding ML workloads start quickly, run efficiently, and remain securely isolated — whether they use a single GPU, hundreds of gigabytes of memory, or multiple GPUs connected with RDMA.We’re looking for a systems engineer who enjoys working deep in the stack. You’ll build production runtime infrastructure in Rust and Go, diagnose difficult Linux and performance problems, and help determine the architecture of Modal’s container platform. You’ll also work closely with maintainers of gVisor and contribute to the runtime itself when the right fix belongs upstream. What you’ll work on Make container startup, checkpoint, and restore dramatically faster for large inference and training workloads. Build multi-GPU and accelerator-aware snapshotting, including efficient handling of GPU memory and RDMA-enabled workloads. Design zero-copy and low-copy data paths between container memory, filesystems, storage, and Modal’s runtime. Optimize large snapshot pipelines using techniques such as parallel uploads, direct I/O, incremental snapshots, and more efficient memory handling. Improve container image and filesystem performance across EROFS, FUSE, page caches, overlay filesystems, and remote storage. Extend our sandboxed runtime to support new GPUs, drivers, profiling tools, and device capabilities across NVIDIA and AMD hardware. Debug complex failures involving system calls, virtual memory, process lifecycle, kernel behavior, GPU drivers, and container isolation. Safely roll out runtime and kernel changes across a heterogeneous fleet using compatibility controls, scheduling constraints, feature flags, and observability. Work across the runtime, scheduler, storage, and GPU infrastructure—and take ambiguous production problems from investigation through deployment. What we’re looking for Strong Linux systems knowledge, particularly processes, virtual memory, filesystems, system calls, scheduling, namespaces, cgroups, and signals. Experience building or debugging container runtimes, sandboxes, Linux kernel, or similarly low-level infrastructure. Strong programming ability in Rust, Go, or another systems language, with an interest in becoming productive in both Rust and Go. Experience profiling and improving systems where memory movement, I/O, synchronization, or kernel interactions dominate performance. Comfort debugging across abstraction boundaries, from application behavior down through runtimes, drivers, and the kernel. An ability to turn loosely defined production problems into well-designed, reliable systems. A desire to own important infrastructure and work closely with both internal teams and customers. Particularly relevant experience Any of the following would be helpful, but none is required: gVisor, runsc , runc , OCI runtimes, seccomp, or checkpoint/restore systems. Linux kernel development, virtualization, sandboxing, kernel modules, or device proxying. CUDA, ROCm, GPU drivers, accelerator virtualization, or GPU profiling. RDMA and high-performance networking. FUSE, EROFS, direct I/O, mmap , page-cache behavior, or storage engines. Large-memory or multi-GPU inference and training systems. Contributions to open-source systems software. Prior gVisor or machine-learning experience is not required. We care more about strong systems fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn unfamiliar parts of the stack. Why this role The container runtime is directly on the critical path for inference performance. Improvements here can substantially reduce cold starts, increase token throughput, unlock new accelerator types, and make previously impractical workloads possible.This is an opportunity to work on unusually deep systems problems with immediate production impact. You’ll have room to shape the architecture, contribute to open-source runtime technology, and take ownership of foundational infrastructure used by every inference and training workload on Modal.

descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Location:  Austin Job Title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloudflare for SaaS Role Summary Cloudflare for SaaS lets SaaS providers offer their services on domains branded for each customer, rather than on the provider's own domain. The product powers customer domains and automates the complex work behind onboarding domains, validating ownership, issuing and renewing certificates, and safely deploying configuration across Cloudflare's global network. The team builds the APIs and control-plane systems used by some of the world's largest platforms. We are evolving these systems to support tens of millions of customer domains, faster and more reliable APIs, simpler configuration at scale, and more Cloudflare products for each customer domain. This work combines customer-facing product development with challenging problems in distributed systems, data modeling, state consistency, observability, and operational reliability. Cloudflare is looking for a Software Engineer to design, build, and operate the services behind Cloudflare for SaaS. You will work primarily on backend services and RESTful APIs in Go and other languages, modernize legacy control-plane workflows, and improve the reliability and scalability of production systems. You will collaborate with product managers and engineers across Cloudflare, write clear technical specifications, review code, instrument services, and help diagnose and resolve operational issues. What You'll Do Design, build, and operate reliable backend services and APIs for managing customer domains and their configuration. Evolve the control plane to support tens of millions of customer domains without sacrificing correctness, availability, or API performance. Improve certificate and domain lifecycle workflows, including onboarding, validation, renewal, migration, and safe deletion. Model ownership and shared state carefully so changes remain consistent across distributed services and configuration stores. Build useful observability, alerts, and operational procedures, and participate in debugging and incident response. Collaborate across engineering and product teams, document designs and tradeoffs, and review the work of fellow engineers. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. The AE will be accountable to obtaining new business and expansion of Cloudflare wallet-share within existing customers. descriptionAr: About the Role OpenAI is seeking a senior individual contributor to support revenue growth across EMEA by helping sales teams structure and close commercially sound deals. You will balance speed and responsiveness with pricing discipline, consistent processes, and appropriate financial and commercial controls. In this role, you will be the day-to-day Deal Operations partner for EMEA account teams, reviewing pricing, discounts, and commercial terms across new business, renewals, and expansions. You will guide sellers through deal requirements, evaluate non-standard requests, and coordinate the approvals needed to move opportunities through contracting and closure. You will also develop scalable workflows, guidance, and tools that improve deal turnaround times, documentation quality, and consistency across the region. This role partners closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, Pricing, and Revenue Operations, with Product and other teams engaged as needed, to resolve deal issues and support accurate execution from quote through contract and booking. In this role, you will: Serve as the primary Deal Operations contact for EMEA account teams, managing deal intake, prioritizing requests, and guiding sellers through pricing, review, and approval processes. Review quotes and proposed commercial terms, including discounts, payment schedules, contract duration, and customer commitments, for accuracy and alignment with pricing guidelines and commercial policies. Build financial analyses and deal models to assess revenue, margin, discount impact, and profitability, and explain the tradeoffs of proposed deal structures to decision-makers. Partner with Sales to structure deals that meet customer needs and OpenAI’s commercial objectives, recommending alternatives when proposed terms fall outside established guidelines. Coordinate deal reviews and required approvals across Finance, Legal, Pricing, and Revenue Operations. Prepare clear recommendations, document decisions, and escalate exceptions to the appropriate stakeholders. Identify risks in non-standard terms and work with Legal and Finance to resolve contractual, billing, and revenue recognition considerations before execution. Maintain complete deal records and approval documentation in CRM, CPQ, and contract management systems, and partner with Revenue Operations to align approved terms, executed agreements, and booking information. Help develop and maintain deal approval policies, escalation paths, pricing guidance, and standardized templates. Improve workflows to reduce bottlenecks while maintaining appropriate controls. Equip sellers with practical guidance and training on deal requirements and approval processes. Apply AI and automation to improve deal intake, knowledge retrieval, and self-service support. Track Deal Desk metrics such as turnaround time, approval bottlenecks, exception trends, and quote accuracy. Use recurring deal patterns to recommend improvements to commercial policies, processes, and tools. You might thrive in this role if you have: 8+ years of experience in Deal Desk, commercial finance, pricing, sales operations, or a related function, preferably in a high-growth technology environment. Hands-on experience reviewing and structuring complex enterprise deals and supporting quoting, commercial approvals, and contracting processes. Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, including experience assessing pricing, discounts, revenue, margins, and deal profitability. Knowledge of enterprise software commercial terms and subscription or consumption-based business models, with the judgment to identify issues that require Legal or Finance review. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain commercial tradeoffs, make clear recommendations, and coordinate timely decisions across teams. Experience with CRM systems, configure-price-quote (CPQ) tools, and contract management platforms, along with strong spreadsheet skills. Attention to detail and a track record of improving approval workflows, documentation, and operational processes as a business scales. Sound commercial judgment and the ability to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines while maintaining accuracy and appropriate controls. A collaborative, hands-on approach to supporting sales teams and familiarity with using AI and automation to improve deal workflows and productivity. descriptionAr: Perplexity is AI for people who expect more. On the data team, that means building the systems that make our data reliable, understandable, and usable by both humans and AI. We're looking for an analytics engineer or data engineer who wants to build the foundation for an AI-native data organization. You'll design core data models, pipelines, semantic layers, data quality systems, governance practices, and warehouse workflows that power the entire company: helping teams make strategic decisions, operate the business, and move faster with trusted data. You'll also make sure those systems are secure, privacy-aware, and legible to AI agents, data scientists, and the rest of the company. This role is for someone who can operate at the boundary of analytics engineering, data engineering, data governance, and internal product. You care about dimensional modeling, dbt standards, cost-aware warehouse design, access controls, privacy, and the details that make data trustworthy. You also believe AI should make the data stack faster, easier to maintain, and more accessible across the company without weakening security or governance. What You'll Do Build the core data foundation - design and maintain high-quality data models, marts, and pipelines that make analysis fast, reliable, and reusable. Manage the data warehouse - help own warehouse architecture, environments, permissions, performance, cost, data lifecycle, and operational hygiene so the platform scales cleanly. Make the warehouse AI-readable - own the documentation, semantic context, metadata, lineage, and retrieval patterns that AI systems depend on to understand and query Perplexity's data correctly. Own data modeling standards - define and champion dbt patterns, dimensional modeling practices, naming conventions, tests, and review processes. Lead data governance practices - define standards for access, ownership, lineage, documentation, retention, quality, and sensitive data handling across the analytical warehouse. Build with security and privacy in mind - partner with engineering, security, legal, and finance where needed to ensure data access, sharing, and AI-enabled workflows are appropriate and controlled. Automate data quality and maintenance - build AI-assisted workflows that detect issues, explain root causes, suggest fixes, generate tests, and reduce manual firefighting. Improve data team productivity - automate repetitive workflows, improve tooling, streamline development, and make it easier for data scientists and stakeholders to answer questions. Partner across the company - work closely with data scientists, engineering, product, finance, and GTM teams to translate analytical needs into durable data systems. Shape tooling decisions - evaluate build-versus-buy tradeoffs, manage vendor relationships when needed, and choose tools that scale with the team. What We're Looking For 6+ years of experience as an analytics engineer, data engineer, data scientist, or closely related role. Deep SQL expertise - you can reason about correctness, performance, joins, grain, and edge cases in complex warehouse queries. Strong data modeling experience - you've worked hands-on with dbt (or a similar transformation framework) in production, and you understand dimensional modeling, data contracts, testing, and how analytical schemas should evolve. Pipeline ownership - you've built, maintained, debugged, and improved production data pipelines. Warehouse management experience - you've worked with warehouse administration, access patterns, permissions, performance tuning, cost management, or operational ownership. Governance mindset - you think clearly about data ownership, access controls, privacy, retention, lineage, auditability, and the risks of making data too easy to access. AI-native working style - you already use AI to speed up development, documentation, QA, exploration, and repetitive workflow automation. Stakeholder fluency - you know how to turn messy analytical requirements into trusted models, metrics, and reusable data assets. Autonomy and execution - you can take projects from ambiguous problem to production-quality system with minimal oversight. Operational judgment - you care about reliability, governance, security, cost, and long-term maintainability. Bonus Snowflake administration, optimization, cost management, or warehouse performance tuning. Experience with RBAC, PII handling, data classification, retention policies, audit workflows, or privacy/security reviews. Experience with Databricks or other modern data infrastructure. Experience building semantic layers, metrics layers, metadata systems, or data catalogs. Python experience for data tooling, automation, orchestration, or quality checks. Previous experience as an early analytics engineer or data engineer at a high-growth startup. Why This Role Own the foundation - your work will determine how fast and confidently the company can use data. Build for humans and AI - the next generation of data infrastructure needs to be understandable by agents as well as analysts. High leverage - better models, pipelines, and tools multiply every data scientist and every stakeholder who depends on data. Small team, broad scope - you'll have room to define standards, choose tools, and ship systems that become company-wide defaults.

You will be responsible for the strategic design of systems across our high-performance global edge network and microservice clusters, providing cross-functional influence to ensure long-term stability and performance. In this leadership role, you will guide capacity planning and the development of next-generation features for Cloudflare Tunnel, Mesh and Zero Trust Network. You will join a team of bright, hard-working, and supportive engineers who are passionate about their craft, and you will be comfortable operating in a fast-paced but sane work environment. Strategically influence and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including security, network engineering, SRE, and product management, to design and scale technical solutions. Review work from your peers throughout all stages of the development lifecycle to ensure high-quality, maintainable code. descriptionAr: About Us At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale. With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world. Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater. About the team: We are a small but mighty team of three analytics engineers powering LangChain’s internal data infrastructure and analytics. We’re a full-stack team, meaning we work end-to-end across the data stack, from data ingestion to enabling self-serve agentic analytics. Learn more about what we’ve built so far here ! About the role: We are expanding our data team and looking for a analytics engineer to join us. We build products used by elite companies and over a million developers, and data plays a critical role in sharping our strategies and decision making. In this role you will help lay the foundation for business teams to diagnose issues, uncover opportunities, and drive success using data. If you enjoy building data infrastructure and empowering teams with actionable insights, this role is for you. *Location: SF, NYC, Boston, or Remote U.S. What you will do: Build scaleable dbt models and context that describe our business, powering a self-serve analytics experience Work with and expand on our foundational data stack — Fivetran, dbt, BigQuery, Hex Connect data from a variety of sources (Salesforce, Stripe, Metronome, Postgres, etc) into our BigQuery warehouse Build dashboards that track progress against company goals and KPIs Analyze product usage and operational data to surface insights around customer health, adoption, and revenue Develop and leverage a deep understanding of our business metrics to drive alignment and decision-making What you'll bring: 3+ years experience in a related role (analytics engineer, data engineer, or similar) Technical proficiency in BigQuery, dbt, Hex, Fivetran, Segment (or similar tools) Detail oriented, enjoys data spelunking, and can synthesize findings effectively Curiosity and a strong business sense to help anticipate needs and generate meaningful insights Start up DNA. You thrive in fast-paced and unstructured environments and are energized by finding out what matters most You are self-directed - you don’t wait for process or oversight to start making an impact Compensation & Benefits: We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, meaningful equity, and benefits such as health and dental coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, and life insurance. Actual compensation will vary based on role, level, and location. For team members in the EU and UK, we provide locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations. Annual salary range: $140,000-$180,000 Compensation Philosophy: We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. Actual compensation and offerings will vary based on role, level, and location. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations. Benefits Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Austin, TX | London , UK | Lisbon , Portugal   About the Team Cloudflare operates one of the largest and most interconnected anycast networks on the Internet. To make that happen, a complex orchestra of IP address configuration and distributed systems need to be in harmony to deliver packets from users, through our edge network and then onwards to our customers origin servers or networks. On the Addressing team, you will architect, program, and maintain core software services that enable large corporate networks to be protected by Cloudflare. Recent projects range from IP conservation efforts, supporting use cases for Policy driven IP address assignment, designing traffic engineering tools that improve the quality of service for billions of users around the world, and building customer APIs to control BGP dynamically. The Addressing team works closely with our system reliability engineers, network engineers  and product engineering teams to build automated systems that span the entire Cloudflare stack. About the role We are looking for talented Software Engineers to join our small but growing team. You will work on a range of microservices written mainly in Go. You’ll be designing and developing new APIs and data models to manage our rapidly expanding addressing needs. The ever growing suite of Cloudflare products and services means our addressing tools are always evolving. You will have the opportunity to take on very impactful projects critical for Cloudflare. You will spend time learning the inner workings of our edge routers, servers, DNS and IP provisioning pipelines. You will work closely with other engineers to understand their needs and create scalable platforms to be used across the company. Some of the technologies we use include Go, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kafka, Lua, Clickhouse, SaltStack, Prometheus and the usual Unix/Linux tools and workflows. We strive to build reliable, fault-tolerant systems that can operate at Cloudflare’s scale. Examples of desirable skills, knowledge, and experience You are naturally curious and willing to take a step to learn something you don’t have experience in You lead. We are a growing team and you will have a huge role shaping our products, tools and system designs from the ground up You have experience writing high-quality code in one or more system programming languages (Go, Python, C/C++) You have experience with modern Unix/Linux development and runtime environments You have a solid understanding of TCP/IP and basic networking in general You have a basic understanding of the HTTP/S/TLS stack You have a working knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL You have experience building and operating distributed systems You have excellent debugging skills and attention to detail when breaking down problems Bonus Points Experience working with Go Experience working with Rust Familiarity with UI design, workflows and implementation Familiarity with anycast or multi-site unicast networks Knowledge of DNS and DNS based traffic management techniques (e.g geo DNS) What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. descriptionAr: About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. About the Role Buying something for a business should not require finance teams to piece together requests, purchase orders, receipts, and invoices across disconnected systems. Ramp is building a procurement experience that helps employees get what they need, gives finance teams control over commitments, and helps businesses pay for what they actually received. As a Product Manager for Ramp’s Procurement offering, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Ramp’s core procurement capabilities, including sourcing, requisition, approval workflows, renewals, purchase orders, receiving, two- and three-way matching, and inventory management. You will work with Engineering, Design, and Data to turn complex purchasing and accounting requirements into products that are easy to start using and reliable as customers grow. AI creates an opportunity to rethink this work: build agentic buying experiences for employees, automate work for approvers and stakeholders, and businesses make better purchasing decisions. You will decide where automation can take work off a customer’s plate, where a direct workflow is faster, and where a person needs to review or approve an action. Success means customers get value quickly, adopt the product in their everyday work, and spend less time chasing information and correcting errors. This role requires working in person at our NYC or SF office at least two days per week. Please note that this role requires in-person presence at our NYC or SF office at least 2 days/week. Build connected workflows across sourcing, requisition, approvals, renewals, purchase orders, receiving, invoice matching, and inventory management. Partner with Bill Pay, Accounting, and platform teams so purchasing records and decisions carry through to payment and customers’ ERP systems. Spend time with finance teams, procurement leaders, purchasing operators, and employees. Turn observed friction into simpler experiences for first-time customers and powerful workflows for complex organizations. Build AI-powered experiences that complete useful work, such as finding new vendors, managing a renewal, drafting a request from a contract, or helping resolve a receipt and invoice discrepancy. Prototype with customers and decide what should be automated, suggested, or handled through direct user controls. Make automation dependable. Partner with Engineering and Data to define quality measures, test realistic customer scenarios, learn from corrections, and provide clear explanations, approval boundaries, audit trails, and recovery when something goes wrong. Own outcomes beyond launch. Define and improve activation, repeat usage, time to complete purchasing work, and the accuracy of matching and exception resolution. Use data and customer research to choose the next iteration. Lead execution with engineers and designers, make scope and sequencing tradeoffs, and align partner teams on dependencies. Work with Sales, Implementation, and Customer Experience to turn customer commitments into repeatable product capabilities and support successful adoption. What You Need At least three years of product management or equivalent product-building experience, with evidence of owning a product area from customer discovery through launch and measurable adoption. Strong product judgment and systems thinking. You can simplify complex workflows while preserving the controls and flexibility customers need. Hands-on AI fluency, demonstrated through products, prototypes, or meaningful projects. You can reason about model quality, latency, cost, and user control, and choose where AI improves the experience. Technical and analytical fluency, developed through a technical or analytical degree or equivalent practical experience. You can work with engineers on data models and integrations, use data to investigate problems, and build prototypes to test ideas. Deep customer curiosity and strong design judgment. You can learn unfamiliar purchasing and finance workflows, distinguish recurring needs from one-off requests, and make the product easier to use. A track record of leading cross-functional teams, setting priorities, making difficult tradeoffs, and delivering outcomes through others. Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain a product direction, a complex workflow, and the reasoning behind a decision to technical and non-technical audiences. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Miami, FL OR Atlanta, GA About the Role: We are seeking an entrepreneurial Sales Director to lead our DN/AI Growth Segment, focusing on both the acquisition and expansion of our fastest-growing Startup accounts. In this role, you will scale a high-performing team tasked with bringing the world’s most innovative AI companies onto Cloudflare's platform. To thrive, you must bring a founder mentality and deep familiarity with the VC ecosystem to capture high-growth startups at inception. You possess a sharp understanding of the dynamics of the hyperscaler market and the AI landscape, allowing you to position Cloudflare as the definitive infrastructure layer for modern workloads. Finally, you are highly familiar with PLG sales motions, knowing exactly how to identify high-potential, self-serve developer accounts and seamlessly transition them into enterprise expansions. Responsibilities: Own and exceed quarterly revenue targets, driving both high-velocity new logo acquisition and strategic account expansion within the AI and startup ecosystem. Recruit, coach, and develop a world-class sales team, instilling a high-tempo, execution-oriented culture tailored to technical buyers. Effectively articulate Cloudflare’s value proposition across our connectivity cloud, including Workers AI, R2 storage, network security, and developer platforms. Partner closely with Product, Growth, and Marketing to seamlessly convert self-serve developer usage into structured enterprise agreements. Act as a key executive sponsor for high-growth startups, founders, and VC partners, positioning Cloudflare as the foundational architecture for the next generation of tech. You might be a good fit if you have: 10+ years of experience in enterprise software sales with at least 3+ leading sales teams A proven track record of leading high-performing sales teams in the cloud infrastructure, SaaS, or developer platform space. A strong understanding of modern application architecture, serverless computing, and how AI startups utilize compute and data storage. Active connections within the tech startup and venture capital ecosystems, with an innate ability to spot and engage high-potential accounts early. Hands-on experience navigating hybrid sales models that blend product-led growth with top-down enterprise execution. A history of thriving in fast-paced, rapidly evolving markets where you can turn ambiguity into clear, actionable sales strategies   What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Have hands-on proficiency with at least two integration platforms, such as Workato, MuleSoft, or Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC). Use Python as a primary development language and have built production applications or integration services with automated testing and sound engineering best practices. Have worked in high-volume environments such as customer-facing e-commerce and understand the supply chain processes behind order management, inventory, fulfillment, and returns. Understand integration patterns, REST and SOAP services, asynchronous messaging, EDI, and data formats such as JSON, XML, and CSV. Have directly built or maintained third-party API integrations and understand OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, pagination, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery. Are comfortable working with AWS or Azure and supporting technologies such as Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis, or Elasticsearch. Have experience with microservices and containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes. Take ownership of systems throughout their production lifecycle, participate in on-call support, and prioritize reliability and operational readiness. Communicate technical issues and business impact clearly to both engineering teams and nontechnical stakeholders. Work independently, navigate ambiguity, and turn business needs into practical technical solutions. Nice to Have Experience building integrations to and from Oracle Fusion ERP or SCM, particularly across planning, procurement, manufacturing, inventory, logistics, and order management. Experience developing MCP servers, plugins, or agentic automation for enterprise workflows. Regular use of AI coding tools such as Codex, with a disciplined approach to reviewing, testing, and validating generated code. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale. With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world. Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater. About the role: We're looking for a Deal Strategy & Operations Lead to join our growing Deal Strategy & Operations team. This role serves as a critical partner to our EMEA sales organization, enabling efficient deal execution while maintaining pricing integrity and revenue quality. You'll be responsible for ensuring all deals are accurately configured in our CPQ system, comply with revenue recognition standards, and align with company policies. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to balance business flexibility with financial discipline. This is an excellent opportunity to gain exposure to the full revenue lifecycle while directly impacting our ability to close deals quickly. Experience working with consumption-based or usage-based pricing models, including structuring deals, managing overage conversations, and ensuring accurate configuration and compliance within CPQ and order form workflows. Detail-oriented, excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to identify areas of improvement and propose necessary changes Strong analytical skills, with a focus on data-driven decision-making to equip the business in a strategic manner and communicate big picture opportunities Ability to work well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility in a fast paced, rapidly changing environment You are skilled at prioritization, effectively balancing urgent support requests with long-term project work. Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments. Available Locations Netherlands About the Role Senior Sales Director – Enterprise, Benelux Drive Growth. Build Elite Teams. Lead with Operational Rigor. This isn’t just a quota-carrying leadership role—it’s a rare opportunity to architect a premier enterprise sales engine for Cloudflare in the Benelux region. Reporting directly to the Area VP, you’ll lead both our Named and Major Accounts teams in the Netherlands, driving strategy, hiring top talent, and scaling revenue while preserving the high-performance culture we’re known for. This role is for builders and strategic sparring partners, not maintainers . We are looking for an entrepreneurial leader who thrives in rapidly changing, hyper-growth environments and brings intense operational rigor to the team. You are a modern leader—someone who understands how to leverage AI tools to analyze data for coaching, accelerate the sales process, and help reps tailor highly contextual business proposals to every customer's unique needs. You will lead from the front, designing GTM strategies, running tight qualification frameworks, and helping your team see new perspectives to unlock complex enterprise deals. Responsibilities What You’ll Own Bring Operational Rigor & Scale – Instill execution excellence across the team by embedding frameworks like MEDDPICC deeply into the sales cycle, ensuring accurate forecasting, and driving high-velocity pipeline generation. Be the Ultimate Deal Sparring Partner – Act as a strategic sounding board for your team. Regularly review account plans, challenge assumptions, help reps see blind spots, and actively coach them on navigating complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals. Drive the Programmable Enterprise Playbook – Empower your team to disrupt rigid, checklist-driven RFP cycles by changing the narrative. You will coach reps to position Cloudflare not just as a standard vendor, but as an agile, programmable platform. While we deliver market-leading security and performance out of the box, our true differentiation is programmability. Help your team show Benelux CIOs and CTOs that instead of waiting months in a legacy vendor's engineering queue for a feature request, their teams can write code natively on Cloudflare to seamlessly tailor our services to their exact environment from day one. Drive Modern Sales Innovation – Equip and guide the team to leverage modern AI tools to accelerate the sales cycle—using data-driven insights for sharp coaching, and employing AI to hyper-tailor business proposals to specific customer challenges. Build & Scale a Team of A-Players – Recruit, onboard, and develop enterprise sellers who consistently exceed quota, while helping them build a strong internal network across Cloudflare's global organization. Craft & Own the Market – Define the enterprise playbook for the Benelux, from territory design to C-suite engagement, leveraging your existing local network to accelerate market footprint. Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience Your Superpowers Proven Enterprise Sales Leader – 7+ years of experience managing and scaling teams in cloud, cybersecurity, or enterprise infrastructure, ideally backed by a strong existing network in the Benelux market. Operational Rigor & MEDDPICC Expert – Deeply operational and process-driven; you know how to run a predictable enterprise forecast and use qualification frameworks to inspect and elevate deals. The Strategic Coach – A passion for deal strategy and people development. You don't just manage KPIs; you get into the trenches to help reps reframe value and build complex business cases. High-Level Architectural & Platform Literacy – Fluency in modern cloud infrastructure and an understanding of why the industry is moving from rigid appliances to programmable edge networks. You can confidently grasp how Zero Trust architectures, Cloud Networking (SASE/SD-WAN), application security, and edge programmability impact an enterprise's strategy. You don't need to write code, but you know how to talk to a CISO or CTO about the power of native custom development vs. legacy vendor engineering lines. descriptionAr: About Sentry Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building. Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future. About the Role You’ll own AI-assisted coding within Sentry’s Platform Engineering organization, building the systems and workflows AI coding agents need to contribute reliably to our codebase. Your work will span engineering teams, with Developer Infrastructure as your home base. Your first focus will be making internal developer systems accessible to agents. Many workflows currently depend on human interaction through a UI. You’ll identify the most valuable gaps, expose those capabilities through APIs, and connect tools such as Claude Code to complete development workflows. From there, you’ll improve the quality of AI-generated pull requests and automate recurring engineering work, including dependency upgrades, minor bug fixes, and maintenance. You’ll build the context and execution environment agents need: relevant repository information, tools and permissions, state management, tests, logs, recovery mechanisms, and evaluations. You’ll partner with engineers across Sentry to understand where agents succeed, where they fail, and which changes improve the development process. This role combines technical direction with hands-on implementation, from choosing the problems to solve through building, measuring, and improving the solutions. This role is based in San Francisco, with three days per week in the office to work closely with Platform teams and engineering leadership. What You’ll Do Set priorities for AI-assisted development at Sentry, using engineer feedback and workflow data to identify where agents would provide the most value. Make internal developer systems accessible through APIs and build integrations enabling agents to complete workflows across those systems. Build context systems and agent execution tooling, including tool access, permissions, checkpoints, retries, and logging. Develop automated checks, evaluations, and feedback loops to improve the correctness, maintainability, and review readiness of AI-generated pull requests. Automate recurring work such as security dependency upgrades, minor bug fixes, and routine maintenance. Improve supporting developer workflows, including issue triage and CI/CD, where they limit agent effectiveness or create repetitive work for engineers. Lead changes across engineering teams, build agreement on priorities, and measure whether the tools reduce manual work and improve delivery. How You Work You’ve used AI coding agents on real development work and have informed views on their strengths, limitations, and failure modes. You bring structure to ambiguous problems, choose a practical starting point, and follow through on delivery. You move comfortably between infrastructure, backend systems, and developer tooling. You know when to build, integrate an existing tool, involve another team, or stop work with limited value. You combine data with direct feedback from engineers to assess whether a solution improves their work. You explain technical tradeoffs clearly and build alignment across teams and senior leadership. Qualifications 10+ years of software engineering experience, including hands-on ownership of production systems. Experience building developer tools, infrastructure, or automation used by engineering teams, such as CI/CD systems, internal APIs, code review tooling, or agent workflows. Hands-on experience using AI coding tools and agents, with an understanding of how context, tool access, and validation affect their output. Prior machine learning experience is not required. Strong software engineering and system design fundamentals, including experience building reliable integrations across systems. A track record of leading cross-team technical initiatives from problem definition through implementation and adoption. Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical decisions and recommendations to senior engineering leaders. Nice to Have Experience building agent harnesses, context systems, evaluations, or automated pull request workflows. Experience with code review tooling, static analysis, or automated testing. Experience measuring and improving developer experience or engineering productivity. Experience with large-scale distributed systems or monolith decomposition. Public contributions to developer tooling or AI-assisted development projects. The base salary range that Sentry reasonably expects to pay for this position is $220,000 to $400,000 USD, plus an annual performance bonus of up to 15% of base salary. A successful candidate’s actual base salary (or hourly wage) amount will be determined by a variety of relevant factors including, without limitation, the candidate’s work location, education, work and other relevant experience, skills, and job-related knowledge. A successful candidate will be eligible to participate in Sentry’s employee benefit plans/programs applicable to the candidate’s position (including incentive compensation, equity grants, paid time off, and group health insurance coverage). See Sentry Benefits for more details about the Company’s benefit plans/programs. descriptionAr: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why the Cohere TPM role? As our Generative Machine Learning organization has continued growing, we are looking for more Technical Program Managers to join the team! At Cohere, TPMs are pivotal to our success, being seen as operational experts specializing in cross-functional efforts. Great TPMs at Cohere are well-rounded, executing with precision at the tactical level, while partnering with senior leaders and shaping the big picture at a strategic level, and the opportunities are endless in growing the scale and impact of their work. Cohere’s TPMs would often be described as organized, execution-oriented, pragmatic leaders who are adaptable to the needs of the company and the programs they lead. As a reward for the depth and breadth of expertize that you bring to the table, you will get to work alongside some of the most talented AI researchers and industry experts in the world on building cutting edge AI technology. No day will be the same as the one before, and the dynamic high growth environment will be absolutely perfect for anyone excited about solving novel problems, bringing structure to oftentimes chaotic and fast-paced environments, and ambitious about scaling their own impact and growth alongside the company! Please note: While we are remote-first and accept candidates from all over the world, we are highly prioritizing hiring for people who are within 1-2 hours of British Standard Time (BST). As a Machine Learning Technical Program Manager, you will: Establish, improve, and scale foundational processes that allow the Generative Modeling teams to execute better, faster, and more predictably Scale the operational capacity and effectiveness of the Modeling TPM team in collaboration with the Modeling TPM lead to ensure the function can remain lean and effective during a period of the program portfolio complexity and size continuing to rapidly increase Flexibly adapt to the needs of the company, programs, and the team from tackling long-horizon programs that can span quarters or even years to jumping onto often highly ambiguous short-term challenges that can have company-wide impact Partner directly with leaders within and outside of the Modeling organization on efforts to design, train and improve our core generative models Lead cross-functional, oftentimes company-wide programs and strategic initiatives, collaborating and coordinating with cross-functional teams such as Product, Engineering, Legal, Platform, Infra, Policy, and Finance Operate as an organizational expert in improving engineering execution rigor and operations on the ground, while contributing to the strategic layer in areas such as long-term strategic planning with senior modeling leadership Map out dependencies and risks, and ensure that cross-functional execution across the program runs smoothly, communicating status with non-technical and technical stakeholders and senior management Both own and enable a useful communication flow of priorities, ideas, and knowledge throughout and beyond the Modeling organization in line with your programs Respond quickly to program-level changes, clarifying new scope, and managing resource needs in response to evolving priorities You may be a good fit if you have: 5-10 years as a Technical Program Manager AND 5+ years of experience working directly on AI/ML. Strong preference for candidates that have worked directly in building foundation models. In-depth knowledge of machine learning, particularly when it comes to Natural Language Processing & Large Language Models (LLMs). Bonus points for experience with Multimodal AI. Experience with working in a chaotic, fast paced, low structure environment. We need someone who is pragmatic, can roll up their sleeves when needed, and can function at the tactical and strategic level to do whatever it takes to make Cohere’s models succeed Personal hands-on understanding of the unique challenges of managing projects and programs in the AI/ML development space as opposed to traditional software program management Managed projects & programs requiring a strong general business acumen, such as coordinating with Finance on reporting needs or Policy on regulatory compliance matters — the broader your experience beyond ML technical program management, the better! (optional, but preferred) Have technical experience in a hands-on capacity. We don’t necessarily need someone with hands on experience training models, but you need to feel comfortable sitting in the same rooms with some of the best researchers in the world, working on highly complex, cutting edge ML problems If some of the above - other than the ML TPM experience - doesn’t line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply! If you consider yourself a thoughtful worker, a lifelong learner, and a kind and playful team member, Cohere is the place for you. We welcome applicants of all kinds and are committed to providing both an equal opportunity process and work environment. We value and celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive work environment for all. Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks: A weekly lunch stip

descriptionAr: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role As Director of Regional Sales for GitLab's National Security Group (NSG), you'll lead a field-based team of Account Executives driving new and expansion revenue across US federal NSG departments. You'll coach and grow the team, spend time with key accounts, and lead large-deal strategy and executive negotiations. Your work will help agencies adopt GitLab's development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) platform through complex federal procurement processes. You'll partner with senior leadership, Renewals, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing to align our sales approach with agency needs. This includes shaping offerings authorized under the Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP), bringing field feedback into the roadmap, and building long-term growth within large agencies. You'll travel as needed for customer meetings and team engagements. What you'll do Recruit, hire, lead, and coach Account Executives covering NSG departments to achieve regional revenue and growth targets while building an accountable, inclusive team. Lead new business and expansion strategy, generating and progressing pipeline across priority accounts to meet or exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets. Own regional forecasting, opportunity data quality, and deal reviews. Use MEDDPICC (Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Decision Process, Paper Process, Identify Pain, Champion, and Competition) to qualify opportunities and give senior leadership clear visibility into pipeline health, commitments, and risks. Guide complex federal procurement processes with distributors and partners, including Carahsoft and systems integrators. Navigate contracting vehicles, funding cycles, and agency-specific buying processes to secure multi-year contracts and expansions. Shape the sales approach for regulated environments, connecting FedRAMP-authorized offerings and mission-critical DevSecOps use cases to agency needs and increasing platform adoption. Work with Renewals, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, and federal partners on account plans, product roadmap feedback, and campaigns that support retention and expansion. Expand within large agencies through new workloads, cross-sells, and upsells, balancing near-term revenue with long-term platform adoption. Meet customers in the field and travel as needed for key account meetings, large-deal reviews, and team engagements. Build senior executive relationships and lead negotiations while working effectively in GitLab's asynchronous environment. What you'll bring Experience in open source software, DevOps, or related enterprise technology sales. A process- and data-driven approach to sales operations, including advanced use of Salesforce and other customer relationship management (CRM) and marketing automation tools. Experience selling or leading teams in regulated or compliance-driven environments, such as FedRAMP or similar government software-as-a-service frameworks, or the ability to learn quickly in highly regulated markets. Success selling and coaching teams through complex enterprise deals with large public sector accounts, including long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders. Familiarity with MEDDPICC or a similar sales methodology, including pipeline generation, qualification, forecasting, and deal reviews. Experience hiring, coaching, developing, and leading regional, field-based sales teams while building an accountable, collaborative, and inclusive team. Skill in managing senior executive relationships and leading executive meetings and negotiations within large organizations with multiple departments and decision-makers. Alignment with GitLab's values and leadership expectations. We welcome transferable skills in enterprise technology sales and team leadership from a range of backgrounds. About the team The NSG sales team is an all-remote organization. We collaborate asynchronously across regions and work with federal distributors and systems integrators, including Carahsoft, to support government customers. Our work supports GitLab's mission to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. We value transparency and collaboration, and you'll have the autonomy and accountability to own your results.
